title: DAY 6 — LESSON 7: WORKING TOGETHER DURING BUSY PERIODS

questions.prompt: What is the most important principle when working together during busy periods?
options: Everybody should focus only on personal duties
Employees should coordinate responsibilities and support one another appropriately
Employees should compete to finish first

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when overwhelmed by several responsibilities?
options: Communicate the workload and request appropriate assistance

questions.prompt: Which action is unacceptable even when the spa is extremely busy?
options: Asking a supervisor to clarify priorities
Skipping required hygiene or safety procedures

questions.prompt: What should happen when two therapists are assigned the same room?
options: They should argue until one gives up
They should seek prompt clarification and coordinate an appropriate solution
They should both promise the room to their clients

questions.prompt: What does the CALM method stand for?
options: Communicate, Assess, Lend support and Maintain standards
Compete, Accuse, Lose focus and Mislead
